TT Spot

Delete your account

TT Spot by Ming Shun Teh · ttspotmy@gmail.com

In the app (fastest)

  1. Open TT Spot and log in.
  2. Go to Me → Menu → Settings.
  3. Scroll down and tap Delete account, type DELETE and confirm.

Your account is deleted straight away.

Without the app

Email ttspotmy@gmail.com from the email address you signed up with, with the subject Delete my TT Spot account and your username. We confirm it is you and delete the account within 7 days, then reply to let you know.

What is deleted

Your account and everything linked to it: profile, username, photos, cars, posts, moments, comments, chat messages and voice notes, meets you created, check-ins, points, vouchers, friends and club memberships, your location and notification settings. This can't be undone.

What we keep

Nothing that identifies you. Server backups roll over and are gone within 30 days.
